title: Kissed Smoky Croatian Meat Skewers
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring roasted meat skewers with a smoky flavor, perfect for a brunch mood. The salted butter and char-grill flavor give it a unique taste.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together melted butter, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the butter mixture.
Thread the pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
